document: REACH Annex II, Part A, consolidated reference 2026-06-22
warning: Each item is a review aid. Conditional wording, exceptions, applicability and legal effective dates need independent human/legal verification. Source is a consolidated documentation text, not itself the authentic OJ act.

items.summary_for_review: Include relevant and available information in appropriate Part B subsections; avoid blank subsections.
items.information_needed: Information available and relevant; non-applicability should be explained where relevant.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Do not insert invented filler merely to avoid blanks.

items.summary_for_review: SDS prepared by a competent person, with suitable training including refreshers.
items.information_needed: Competent person and training documentation.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Cannot be inferred from phrase usage.

items.summary_for_review: Identify substance/mixture consistently with CLP label and registration data where relevant.
items.information_needed: Product type, registered substance status, identifiers, registration number and relevant derogations.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Distributor/joint-registration limitations and nanoforms are separately conditional.

items.summary_for_review: Where UFI is indicated in the SDS under CLP Annex VIII, provide it in subsection 1.1.
items.information_needed: Whether mixture has UFI and whether SDS is the chosen placement.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Not an unconditional requirement to include a UFI on every SDS.

items.summary_for_review: Provide relevant identified uses, and where applicable uses advised against and reasons.
items.information_needed: Recipient uses, uses advised against, chemical safety report if needed.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Exhaustiveness not required; consistency across CSR/exposure scenarios may apply.

items.summary_for_review: Identify SDS supplier including address, telephone and competent-person email.
items.information_needed: Supplier, Member State market and any nominated responsible person.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Additional representative address is conditional.

items.summary_for_review: Reference emergency information service and state any limits on availability.
items.information_needed: Destination Member State, national advisory number, opening hours and service limits.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Do not hardcode a generic national number.

items.summary_for_review: Show CLP classification, or explicitly state where mixture does not meet classification criteria.
items.information_needed: Valid EU CLP classification and classification completeness evidence.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Not determined by this REACH text alone; CLP rules live separately.

items.summary_for_review: Show applicable CLP pictograms, signal words, hazard and precautionary statements and supplemental label elements.
items.information_needed: Verified classification, CLP Article 25/32 conditions, label content.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: CLP Annex IV controls precautionary-statement selection; not this inventory.

items.summary_for_review: Address PBT/vPvB and endocrine-disruption status and relevant other non-classification hazards.
items.information_needed: Substance and relevant mixture ingredient data and concentrations.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Some mixture reporting depends on ingredient concentration at least 0.1% by weight.

items.summary_for_review: For classified mixtures identify ingredients meeting applicable concentration criteria and specified additional categories.
items.information_needed: All ingredient hazard classes/categories, SCLs, generic thresholds, M-factors, OELs, PBT/vPvB/ED and composition.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Table 1.1 is only one threshold source; use the lowest applicable listed threshold with the detailed exceptions.

items.summary_for_review: For unclassified mixtures disclose ingredients meeting the distinct threshold/condition rules.
items.information_needed: Mixture form and classification, substance flags, SCLs, sensitisation, CMR, OELs, composition.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Rules vary by gas/non-gas and hazard; do not reuse Table 1.1 unconditionally.

items.summary_for_review: Provide first-aid instructions by relevant exposure route, separated for inhalation, skin, eye and ingestion as appropriate.
items.information_needed: Credible exposure routes, toxicological response and product-specific first aid.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: No generic phrase can cover every mixture.

items.summary_for_review: Explain when medical attention, fresh air, clothing removal and responder PPE are advised.
items.information_needed: Product-specific emergency response assessment.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Each subitem must be assessed, not assumed yes.

items.summary_for_review: Summarise the most important acute and delayed symptoms/effects.
items.information_needed: Toxicological evidence and exposure routes.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Effects should align with Section 11.

items.summary_for_review: Identify suitable media and any unsuitable media for fire scenarios.
items.information_needed: Fire and incompatibility assessment.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Media may vary by chemistry and packaging.

items.summary_for_review: Provide appropriate environmental spill precautions.
items.information_needed: Spill scenarios and environmental hazards.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Do not infer total prohibition solely from the presence of a phrase.

items.summary_for_review: Provide safe storage conditions appropriate to physical/chemical properties, including relevant incompatibilities and risk controls.
items.information_needed: Physical properties, packaging, ventilation, incompatible materials, exposure scenarios.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Items (a)-(d) have conditional qualifiers; do not universally prescribe sealed storage.

items.summary_for_review: Report applicable Member State occupational/biological exposure limits and legal bases where available.
items.information_needed: Destination Member State, relevant substances, local and EU limit lists.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Cannot be answered from a worldwide generic threshold alone.

items.summary_for_review: Specify suitable PPE; glove selection includes material, thickness and breakthrough times when hand protection is used.
items.information_needed: Task exposure, product chemistry, glove tests, applicable standards.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Generic 'wear gloves' may not be sufficiently specific.

items.summary_for_review: Report listed basic physical and chemical properties and explain non-applicability or unavailable data where possible.
items.information_needed: Product state, measurement, method, mixture/test availability.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Properties have different applicability rules (gas/liquid/solid, mixture, nanoform).

items.summary_for_review: Address each listed health hazard class and explain the basis for absence of classification.
items.information_needed: Toxicological studies, mixture rationale and CLP evidence.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: 'Not classified' needs the prescribed type of explanation; no-data is not equivalent to not hazardous.

items.summary_for_review: Provide available relevant ecotoxicity results, considering modelling where experimental data absent.
items.information_needed: Environmental test results, component context, relevant endpoints.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Section 12 includes separate rules for other properties (12.2-12.7).

items.summary_for_review: Set out waste treatments for product and contaminated packaging, and applicable provisions.
items.information_needed: Waste properties, intended disposal practices and Member State regulations.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Waste code and disposal method are product/country specific.

items.summary_for_review: Supply relevant transport classifications by applicable modes or explain unavailable/not relevant information.
items.information_needed: DG classification and transport modes.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: ADR/IMDG/ICAO etc are separate classification rule sources.

items.summary_for_review: Apply maritime-bulk information only where cargo is intended to be carried in bulk under specified IMO instruments.
items.information_needed: Bulk carriage status, IMO code and cargo type.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Not obligatory for every packaged-goods SDS.

items.summary_for_review: Indicate whether supplier has carried out chemical safety assessment.
items.information_needed: CSA status of supplier.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Does not mean a CSA is always required.

items.summary_for_review: Give full text of relevant hazard/precautionary statements not written out in full elsewhere.
items.information_needed: SDS Sections 2-15 wording and verified H/P statement list.
items.exception_or_qualification_warning: Statement selection remains governed by CLP/other relevant instruments.
